identity.title: Data Center & AI Infrastructure
identity.target_learners: Grades 6-12 (DISCOVER: 6-8, EXPLORE: 9-10, PREPARE_PROVE: 11-12; a TRANSITION stage is defined with no grade band and is not yet implemented)

course_refs: 13 course records defined in src/content/curriculum/data-center-pathway-map.json (grades 6-12, including 6 distinct Grade-12 specialization courses plus one non-executable capstone)
lesson_refs: 168 lesson JSON files total under src/content/lessons/data-center-*-student/: grade 6 (10), grade 7 (10), grade 8 (10), grade 9 (14), grade 10 (14), grade 11 (58), grade 12 (52)
assessment_refs: Per-lesson quiz/rubric fields inside all 168 lesson JSON files (client-side content only, not DB-backed)

CORRECTION (Phase 2 discovery, 2026-09-14): 41 DB-backed proof/competency activities are defined in apps/shs-api/src/domain/prepare-prove/service/prepare-prove-service.ts (PROOF_CONFIGS), spanning all 6 specializations at grades 11-12 (6-7 activities per specialization). 31 of the 168 lesson files carry a populated `proofActivity` field wired to this system via the generic ProofActivity component in src/components/curriculum/lesson/GuidedLessonExperience.jsx, which calls the real /api/prepare-prove/proof-status, /activity-results, and /evidence endpoints. This materially updates (and supersedes, for these fields) the original Phase 1 pilot audit's 'exactly 1 competency' finding, which was based only on migration-seeded rows and missed this in-code/on-demand-upserted registry.

competency_refs: 41 named proof/competency configs in apps/shs-api/src/domain/prepare-prove/service/prepare-prove-service.ts (PROOF_CONFIGS), each upserted into the real competency_definitions table on first read by getProofDefinition() — not limited to the single migration-seeded row (competency_prepare_prove_monitoring_finding) found in the original Phase 1 pass.

Coverage: technical-operations (6), networking-fiber (7), electrical-infrastructure (7), mechanical-hvac (7), cybersecurity-security (7), ai-cloud-infrastructure (7) — all 6 specializations, grades 11 and 12.
skills: Representative example (grade11-technical-operations-monitoring-proof): records observations accurately, identifies a plausible affected system, separates evidence from uncertainty, recommends a safe next step.

Each of the 41 configs defines its own 3-7 criteria specific to its domain (e.g. electrical load/capacity reasoning, network topology interpretation, HVAC thermal/airflow interpretation, security access-control analysis, AI/cloud workload and capacity analysis) — not enumerated individually here; see the source file for the full list.
professional_practice_expectations: Safety block in data-center-pathway-map.json: 'Classroom simulation and low-voltage learning are distinct from professional electrical or mechanical work'; adultSupervisionRequired: true; hazardousWorkDeferredToQualifiedPartners: true.

Individual proof-activity descriptions repeatedly encode the same boundary in domain-specific language, e.g. 'without performing electrical work', 'without performing industrial HVAC work', 'avoids unauthorized action'.

practical_activities: `practice`/`lab` fields present across many of the 168 lesson files (hands-on activities embedded in content).

31 of the 168 lesson files additionally carry a `proofActivity` field driving a real, interactive, backend-graded practice activity (see competency_refs above) — concentrated in the grade-11/12 specialization tracks.
project_requirements: Grade 12 capstone ('Build Ohio's Next AI Data Center') is architecturally defined in data-center-pathway-map.json but explicitly status ARCHITECTURE_DEFINED_NON_EXECUTABLE / transition.status PLANNING_ONLY / partnerCommitments NONE — cannot be completed end-to-end today.

Separately, several grade-11/12 lessons named '*-project.json' (e.g. technical-operations-project, ai-cloud-project, networking-fiber-project, and grade-12 'advanced-*-project' variants) DO carry real proofActivity wiring and are not the same thing as the non-executable capstone.
simulation_refs: SIMULATED_INFRASTRUCTURE_PROOF activity type (apps/shs-api/src/domain/prepare-prove) — CORRECTED activity-type string (Phase 1 recorded 'SIMULATED_INFRASTRUCTURE_MONITORING' in error; the real constant is SIMULATED_INFRASTRUCTURE_PROOF). This is a real, working, permission-gated practical-evidence pipeline covering 41 activities, not a single one.

assessment.knowledge_assessment: Per-lesson `quiz` fields across all 168 files, client-side content only, not DB-backed.
assessment.practical_assessment: prepare-prove competency review workflow (DEMONSTRATED / EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT / NEEDS_REVIEW), DB-backed and permission-gated (requires an active program_specialization_assignments / program_course_assignments record), covering 41 named proof activities across all 6 specializations at grades 11-12 — corrected from Phase 1's 'one seeded competency' finding, which only checked migration-seeded rows, not the in-code registry that upserts rows on demand.
assessment.demonstration_requirements: Defined per-specialization across all 6 tracks (6-7 activities each); whether any real learner has actually completed one in a live database was not verified in this pass — that would require live database inspection, which is out of scope for a repository audit.

evidence_requirements: SIMULATED_INFRASTRUCTURE_PROOF activity results feed prepare_prove_evidence records (createEvidence()), one per criterion, across all 41 proof-activity configs — not limited to the single migration-seeded competency Phase 1 originally found.
artifact_requirements: Defined per proof-activity config (3-7 criteria each); not enumerated individually here — see apps/shs-api/src/domain/prepare-prove/service/prepare-prove-service.ts.
verification_requirements: learner_competency_decisions review workflow, reviewer required, for each submitted evidence record.
evidence.portfolio_relationships: apps/shs-api/src/domain/portfolio POST /portfolio/artifacts/from-evidence exists and is real, but its eligibleSource() query requires source_type='STUDIO_DELIVERY' joined to studio_delivery_records/projects — it does NOT currently accept prepare-prove's SIMULATED_INFRASTRUCTURE_PROOF evidence type (corrected activity-type name; Phase 1 recorded this as 'SIMULATED_INFRASTRUCTURE_MONITORING' in error). None of the 41 real Data Center evidence pipelines can currently reach Portfolio without adaptation — this gap is broader than Phase 1 stated, but the underlying limitation (Portfolio's STUDIO_DELIVERY-only intake) is the same.

credential.shf_completion_credential: foundation.data-center-ai-infrastructure-pathway (apps/shs-api/src/domain/credentials/model/certificate-profile.ts) — certificateType PROGRAM_COMPLETION, status ACTIVE in config, canonicalProgramReference 'data-center-specialization-11'. NOT operational: no credential_definitions DB row is seeded for it, and canonicalProgramReference points at a programs-table row that does not exist (0 rows ever inserted into programs across all 142 migrations).

education_training_partners: data-center-pathway-map.json lists partnerCategories per specialization (e.g. 'data center operators', 'community colleges', 'apprenticeship providers', 'unions') and its own boundaries.employerStatus field says: 'DEFERRED: partner categories are planning references, not commitments'. Treated here as NOT a partner list.

work_based_learning.placement_status: data-center-pathway-map.json's own transition.notYetImplemented field lists: credentials, internships, apprenticeships, employment matching, readiness scoring.

accommodation_requirements: Platform-wide accessibility profile/CSS layer (src/styles/curriculum-a11y.css, src/context/EffectiveAccessibilityContext.jsx) applies to all Curriculum content including Data Center, covering text scale, contrast, focus emphasis, target size, and reduced motion — real and tested (tests/aielPhase4CurriculumAccessibility.test.mjs), but not Data-Center-specific in its test coverage.
Zero per-lesson accessibility metadata fields exist in any of the 168 Data Center lesson JSON files.

New AX-3 accessibility-content service (apps/shs-api/src/domain/accessibility-content) can generate accessible representations of lessons, but only for lessons imported into the DB curriculum_lessons/units/courses tables; Data Center content has a real import adapter (curriculum-import-source-adapter.ts) but no evidence it has ever been executed against a live database.

sel_readiness.reflection: PRESENT — reflectionPrompt field in all 168/168 lesson files.
sel_readiness.communication: Not an explicit per-lesson field; mentioned only at the non-executable Grade-12 capstone architecture level (team roles).
sel_readiness.teamwork: Same as communication — capstone-architecture-level only, non-executable.
sel_readiness.goal_setting: Not an explicit field anywhere in sampled/searched content.
sel_readiness.professional_identity: Touched indirectly in transition-lesson objectives, e.g. 'distinguish learning completion from reviewed competency' (data-center-specialization-12-career-postsecondary-transition.json).
sel_readiness.decision_making: Not an explicit field; the competency review process itself models evidence-based decision-making for reviewers, not as learner-facing SEL content.

outcome.next_step_definition: Within-curriculum: real and honest — every lesson has a `nextSlug` field; transition lessons explicitly frame next steps as options to compare, 'without promises'. External to curriculum: MISSING — the TRANSITION stage in data-center-pathway-map.json has no grade band and is explicitly not yet implemented; no real external next step (state pathway, employer validation, work-based learning) exists today.
